_note: Gate runs ONE slide at a time — caller iterates over all rendered PNGs (slide-01.png … slide-NN.png) and calls eval-run.sh on each. All checks are per-image. cover_is_moneyshot applies to slide-01 during the vision pass; the perceptual reviewer skips it for content/hero/cta slides.

checks.desc: (a) No text is clipped, cut at an edge, or overflowing its container — headline, eyebrow, body, stat, nodes, and footer are all fully visible within the 1080x1350 canvas.
(b) Text-to-background contrast is strong and legible at thumbnail size — no light-grey-on-dark, no same-hue collisions.
(c) Palette matches the carousel spec theme (bg, accent, text fields) — not off-brand or generic stock-template colors.

(d) Clear premium hierarchy — oversized condensed headline dominant, ghost keyword present as background atmosphere, glow adds depth; slide kind (cover/content/hero/cta) reads as intended per the spec.
(e) Margins and padding are consistent with the other slides in the set — same grid rhythm and spacing; no slide looks out-of-family.
(f) Cover slide (slide-01) is the strongest, most eye-catching beat — bright, high-contrast, a hook that makes a viewer stop scrolling. (Non-cover slides: skip this check during the vision pass.)
